info.title: hugmesh-wiki-bff-api
info.description: Wiki BFF API (/bff/wiki/**) — TIER 1 of the 3-tier wiki: the writable Postgres content store (wiki_page/wiki_attachment/wiki_audit_log) the admins author markdown into. Read (list/get) gated WIKI_READ (admin|superadmin|mod+WIKI); edit (create/update, markdown->HTML at write, version bump) + publish gated WIKI_WRITE (admin|superadmin); manage gated WIKI_MANAGE (superadmin). The rendered content_html is the source the ZIM (re)build (PR4) packages for kiwix-serve (TIER 3 READ). All surfaces are domain-scoped per multi-brand: a scoped ADMIN sees only own-brand pages.

tags.name: Wiki Access
tags.description: Wiki grant/timeout/ban overlay (wiki_access): grant/timeout/ban/restore (WIKI_WRITE), list-all/history (WIKI_MANAGE). Domain-scoped; enforced at request time by WikiAccessGuard.

tags.name: Wiki
tags.description: Wiki BFF (TIER 1 content store): list/get (WIKI_READ), create/update/publish (WIKI_WRITE), audit (WIKI_MANAGE). Domain-scoped per brand.

tags.name: Wiki Attachments
tags.description: Per-page binary attachments (wiki_attachment table). Upload/delete: ADMIN/SUPERADMIN. Download/list: USER (authenticated).

put.summary: Update a wiki page by slug (renders markdown->HTML, bumps version; stale expectedVersion -> 409). ADMIN/SUPERADMIN.
put.description: Update a wiki page by slug (renders markdown to HTML at write, bumps version). A stale expectedVersion (a concurrent overwrite) is a 409. ADMIN/SUPERADMIN only.

200.description: Updated page (markdown source + rendered HTML snapshot, bumped version).

400.description: Validation error — title or contentMarkdown failed a constraint.

403.description: Caller is not ADMIN or SUPERADMIN.

404.description: Slug not found in the caller's brand.

409.description: Stale expectedVersion — the page was concurrently modified.

delete.summary: Delete a wiki page by slug (cascades to its attachments; audited). ADMIN/SUPERADMIN.
delete.description: Delete a wiki page by slug, resolved in the caller's scope (the caller's brand; any brand for a SUPERADMIN) and deleted by that row's id, so no other brand's same-slug page can be touched. Cascades to its attachments. Audited in the brand the page lived in. ADMIN/SUPERADMIN only.

204.description: Exactly one page row (and its attachments) was deleted.

403.description: Caller is not ADMIN or SUPERADMIN.

404.description: Slug not found in the caller's scope, or the resolved page was already gone when the delete ran (nothing was removed).

post.summary: Create a wiki page (renders markdown->HTML, version 1). ADMIN/SUPERADMIN.
post.description: Create a wiki page (renders markdown to HTML at write, version 1). The slug must be unique within the caller's brand. ADMIN/SUPERADMIN only.

200.description: Created page (markdown source + rendered HTML snapshot, version 1).

400.description: Validation error — slug, title, or contentMarkdown failed a constraint.

403.description: Caller is not ADMIN or SUPERADMIN.

409.description: Slug already exists in the caller's brand.

post.summary: Publish a wiki page by slug (audited; the next ZIM rebuild packages it). ADMIN/SUPERADMIN.
post.description: Mark a wiki page as published (sets is_published=true, published_at=now()). Audited; the next ZIM rebuild will package published pages. ADMIN/SUPERADMIN only.

403.description: Caller is not ADMIN or SUPERADMIN.

404.description: Slug not found in the caller's brand.

post.summary: Upload a binary attachment to a page (multipart/form-data; file part = 'file'). ADMIN/SUPERADMIN.
post.description: Upload a binary attachment to a page (multipart/form-data; part name = 'file'). The domain is server-derived from the caller's JWT. ADMIN/SUPERADMIN only.

200.description: Saved attachment metadata (id, filename, mimeType, createdAt)

413.description: Attachment exceeds the configured size ceiling

post.summary: TIMEOUT a USER from wiki read for a bounded window (an active banned override with a future expires_at; auto-restores on expiry). ADMIN/SUPERADMIN, own-brand.
post.description:
Creates (or returns existing active) a {@code banned} override row with a future {@code expires_at} computed from {@code ttlSeconds}. Once the timestamp passes, {@link WikiAccessGuard} treats the row as inactive — no write is needed on expiry. Idempotent: an existing active {@code banned} row is returned unchanged.
RolePermittedScope
ADMINYesOwn brand only
SUPERADMINYesCross-domain: the named targetDomain brand; the single configured brand when only one is configured; the platform default domain only when no brand is configured at all
MOD / USERNo—

200.description: Active wiki_access banned override returned (newly created or pre-existing idempotent row).

400.description: Request body validation failed (e.g. missing userSubject or non-positive ttlSeconds), OR the SUPERADMIN targetDomain does not name a brand this deployment configures (with 2+ brands it must name one; with exactly 1 it may be omitted but must not name a different one).

401.description: No valid JWT present in the request.

403.description: Caller does not hold ADMIN or SUPERADMIN role.

500.description: Unexpected DB error writing the override row.

post.summary: GRANT a USER permanent wiki read access (an active wiki_access read override). ADMIN/SUPERADMIN, own-brand.
post.description:
Creates (or returns existing active) a {@code read} override row for the target user in the actor's brand. Idempotent: if an active {@code read} row already exists for this user in this brand it is returned unchanged.
RolePermittedScope
ADMINYesOwn brand only
SUPERADMINYesCross-domain: the named targetDomain brand; the single configured brand when only one is configured; the platform default domain only when no brand is configured at all
MOD / USERNo—

200.description: Active wiki_access read override returned (newly created or pre-existing idempotent row).

400.description: Request body validation failed (e.g. missing or blank userSubject), OR the SUPERADMIN targetDomain does not name a brand this deployment configures (with 2+ brands it must name one; with exactly 1 it may be omitted but must not name a different one).

401.description: No valid JWT present in the request.

403.description: Caller does not hold ADMIN or SUPERADMIN role.

500.description: Unexpected DB error writing the override row.

post.summary: BAN a USER from wiki read permanently (an active banned override, expires_at NULL). Denies even a role-holder/grantee. ADMIN/SUPERADMIN, own-brand.
post.description:
Creates (or returns existing active) a permanent {@code banned} override row ({@code expires_at} NULL). The ban takes precedence over any role-based read permission; {@link WikiAccessGuard} denies access on every request until the row is revoked. Idempotent: an existing active {@code banned} row is returned unchanged.
RolePermittedScope
ADMINYesOwn brand only
SUPERADMINYesCross-domain: the named targetDomain brand; the single configured brand when only one is configured; the platform default domain only when no brand is configured at all
MOD / USERNo—

200.description: Active wiki_access banned override returned (newly created or pre-existing idempotent row).

400.description: Request body validation failed (e.g. missing or blank userSubject), OR the SUPERADMIN targetDomain does not name a brand this deployment configures (with 2+ brands it must name one; with exactly 1 it may be omitted but must not name a different one).

401.description: No valid JWT present in the request.

403.description: Caller does not hold ADMIN or SUPERADMIN role.

500.description: Unexpected DB error writing the override row.

get.summary: The BRAND CATALOGUE for the target-brand picker: every value this bff accepts as targetDomain, the domain the wiki is launched on, and whether targetDomain is consulted at all. SUPERADMIN.
get.description:
Serves the authoritative brand set the SUPERADMIN cross-brand writes are validated against, so the console can offer a PICKER instead of free text. Backed by the same DomainRegistry the write path validates against:
  • brands — DomainRegistry.knownDomains() filtered through DomainRegistry.isKnownDomain, i.e. exactly the values a grant/timeout/ban may name in targetDomain. Sorted. Empty ONLY on a back-compat deployment that configures no brand at all (app.tenancy.issuers unset); a deployment with exactly ONE configured pair is still single-issuer to the decoder but DOES list that one brand.
  • launchDomain — the domain this wiki is launched on, from the same derivation the 007 re-stamp target uses; falls back to hugmesh. NOT necessarily a member of brands: on a 2+-brand deployment there is no single launch domain, so check membership before preselecting it.
  • targetDomainHonoured — whether WikiAccessService.writeDomain reads the field at all. True whenever at least one real brand is configured (with exactly one, the field may be omitted and that brand is stamped, while naming a different brand is a 400). False only on a back-compat single-issuer deployment, where every principal is default, the field is inert and brands is empty — so false now always means there is nothing to pick, never that a real choice is being discarded.
No new disclosure: a SUPERADMIN is cross-domain by definition and can already read every brand's access rows and audit trail.
RolePermittedScope
SUPERADMINYesAll brands
ADMIN / MOD / USERNo—

200.description: The brand catalogue. brands may be an empty list — only on a back-compat deployment that configures no brand at all, which is also the only shape where targetDomain is ignored.

401.description: No valid JWT present in the request.

403.description: Caller does not hold SUPERADMIN role.

get.summary: Read the wiki_audit_log content-edit trail (newest first, scoped to the caller's brand; SUPERADMIN sees all). Bounded: the optional ?limit is clamped to [1, 1000] and defaults to 200. SUPERADMIN.
get.description: Read the wiki_audit_log content-edit trail (scoped to the caller's brand; SUPERADMIN sees all brands). Returns newest-first. Bounded: the optional ?limit is clamped to [1, 1000] and defaults to 200 — the read is a bounded newest-first scan, never a full-table drain. SUPERADMIN only.

200.description: List of audit entries, newest first (bounded page).

get.summary: List all ACTIVE wiki_access overrides (scoped to the caller's brand; SUPERADMIN sees all). SUPERADMIN.
get.description:
Returns all currently active (non-revoked, non-expired) {@code wiki_access} rows visible to the caller. A scoped SUPERADMIN will see every brand's active overrides (the repository applies no domain filter when the actor's scope is null). Returns an empty list when no active overrides exist — never 404.
RolePermittedScope
SUPERADMINYesAll brands
ADMIN / MOD / USERNo—

200.description: List of active wiki_access overrides (may be an empty list when none exist).

401.description: No valid JWT present in the request.

403.description: Caller does not hold SUPERADMIN role.

500.description: Unexpected DB error reading override rows.

get.summary: The full grant/timeout/ban HISTORY (active + revoked = audit) for a principal (scoped to the caller's brand; SUPERADMIN sees all). SUPERADMIN.
get.description:
Returns all {@code wiki_access} rows (both active and revoked) for the given {@code userSubject}. Revoked rows are retained permanently for audit. Returns an empty list — never 404 — when no history exists for the subject.
RolePermittedScope
SUPERADMINYesAll brands
ADMIN / MOD / USERNo—

200.description: Full audit history for the subject (active + revoked rows). Empty list when no history exists — never 404.

401.description: No valid JWT present in the request.

403.description: Caller does not hold SUPERADMIN role.

500.description: Unexpected DB error reading history rows.

get.summary: List wiki pages (summaries) in the caller's brand.
get.description: List wiki page summaries (no heavy content columns) in the caller's brand. The REAL read gate is WikiAccessGuard (ADMIN | SUPERADMIN | (MOD+WIKI) or an active grant, AND NOT an active ban). The gateway enforces the ROLE_WIKI route-access floor.

200.description: List of page summaries for the caller's brand.

403.description: Caller is banned or does not hold a qualifying role or grant.

get.summary: Get a wiki page (markdown + rendered HTML) by slug in the caller's brand.
get.description: Get a wiki page (markdown source + rendered HTML) by slug in the caller's brand. Same WikiAccessGuard gate as listPages.

200.description: Full page (markdown source + rendered HTML snapshot).

403.description: Caller is banned or does not hold a qualifying role or grant.

404.description: Page not found in the caller's brand.

get.summary: List attachment metadata for a page (no binary data). USER/ADMIN/SUPERADMIN via WikiAccessGuard.
get.description: List attachment metadata (filename, mimeType, createdAt — no binary data) for a page by slug in the caller's brand. Requires WIKI_READ_AUTHENTICATED + WikiAccessGuard (ADMIN | SUPERADMIN | MOD+WIKI, or an active grant; rejected if actively banned).

200.description: List of attachment metadata (no binary data)

403.description: Banned caller, or no qualifying role/grant

get.summary: Download a single attachment (streams the raw bytes with the stored mime type). USER/ADMIN/SUPERADMIN via WikiAccessGuard.
get.description: Download a single attachment's raw bytes for a page by slug + filename, served with the stored MIME type. Same WikiAccessGuard gate as listAttachments.

200.description: Raw bytes with Content-Type set to the stored mimeType

403.description: Banned caller, or no qualifying role/grant

404.description: Attachment not found for the given slug and filename

delete.summary: Delete an attachment from a page by filename. ADMIN/SUPERADMIN.
delete.description: Delete an attachment by page slug + filename in the caller's brand. ADMIN/SUPERADMIN only.

404.description: Attachment not found for the given slug and filename

delete.summary: RESTORE/REVOKE: lift the active override of a type for a user (CAS active->revoked; the row is retained = audit). accessType = read|banned: revoke 'banned' to restore read; revoke 'read' to remove a grant. ADMIN/SUPERADMIN, own-brand.
delete.description:
CAS-transitions the active override of the given {@code accessType} to {@code revoked} state. The row is never deleted (audit retention). If no active row of that type exists for the user in the actor's brand the call is a no-op and still returns 200. {@code accessType} must be exactly {@code read} or {@code banned}; any other value yields 400.
RolePermittedScope
ADMINYesOwn brand only
SUPERADMINYesCross-domain (platform default)
MOD / USERNo—

200.description: Override revoked (or was already absent — no-op). Body contains state=revoked, accessType, userSubject.

400.description: accessType path variable is not 'read' or 'banned'.

401.description: No valid JWT present in the request.

403.description: Caller does not hold ADMIN or SUPERADMIN role.

500.description: Unexpected DB error during the CAS update.
